title: Telegram funnel runtime repair and review submission
requirements: Repair TG-012 against current ChannelConversation and PublicCatalogRuntime shapes: accept positive non-bool draft versions for SAVED/REQUESTER and RESET/START; accept NEGOTIATED null duration/price with RUB and FIXED_PER_PERSON positive duration, RUB money 0..9000000000000; match TelegramActionResolver active-option flattening exactly without service.active semantics.

For successful SAVED REQUESTER, DETAILS and REVIEW results, enrich data only with normalized answers and the current public catalog without changing persistence, mutations, action counts, event/version or accepted contracts. Keep catalog and answers unmutated and prove Telegram/VK equivalence.

Extend TelegramScreenActionResolver only for OPEN/DETAILS. Strictly parse exactly five Russian labelled lines for participants 1..100, ISO date, optional time, experience, and optional comment; reject whitespace/NUL/reordering/duplicates/extras safely as INVALID_DETAILS_INPUT, map to immutable SET_DETAILS, and preserve TG-010 requester behavior and orchestrator's two calls / maximum one mutation.

Render enriched SAVED REQUESTER, DETAILS and REVIEW without IDs, versions or metadata. DETAILS shows selected service and an exact copyable five-line template. REVIEW shows normalized summary and submit/reset/help buttons (v1:u, v1:r, v1:h). Preserve existing SELECT_SERVICE/HELP/RESET/ACCEPTED behavior and fail closed for unsupported combinations.

Add deterministic end-to-end tests using actual trusted Telegram mapper/action/screen/orchestrator/renderer path with a recording fake gateway. Cover full funnel, exact mutations/events/versions, malformed details, stale selection and duplicate submit. Do not add SDK, network, webhook, persistence, routes, config, docs, logging or protocol changes.
acceptance: Focused channel, Telegram action/render/orchestrator, funnel, all Telegram, channel regression and full pytest gates pass along with git diff --check.
Self-review compares renderer input validation to actual ConversationResult and PublicCatalogRuntime shapes; diff remains within allowed paths.
